providing_module.name: Plausibility module
providing_module.role: Compares a base measurement against its redundant counterpart and returns whether the two agree to within a configured tolerance. On agreement it also writes the averaged value out, so the caller receives both a verdict and a value from one call. It is a pure function of its inputs: it reads no database entry and publishes nothing itself.

consuming_modules.name: Redundancy module, MRC
consuming_modules.consumption_evidence: The redundancy module owns the base and redundancy-0 tables that these elements take as arguments; MRC_ValidateAfeMeasurement at src/app/application/redundancy/redundancy.c L1111 reads exactly those tables and is the natural caller. The anchor FB2-SRC-COD-000031 records the redundancy side of this boundary at src/app/application/redundancy/redundancy.c L658-L673.

elements.declaration: extern STD_RETURN_TYPE_e PL_CheckStringVoltage(int32_t voltageAfe_mV, int32_t voltageCurrentSensor_mV);

parameters.name: voltageAfe_mV
parameters.meaning: String voltage as measured by the AFE.
parameters.valid_range: No range is stated or checked by the source. The unit is carried in the parameter name only.
parameters.range_evidence: No assertion on this parameter. The source applies none at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L77-L86.

parameters.name: voltageCurrentSensor_mV
parameters.meaning: String voltage as measured by the current sensor.
parameters.valid_range: No range is stated or checked by the source.
parameters.range_evidence: No assertion on this parameter. The source applies none at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L77-L86.

values.STD_OK: The two measurements differ by less than PL_STRING_VOLTAGE_TOLERANCE_mV.
values.STD_NOT_OK: The two measurements differ by PL_STRING_VOLTAGE_TOLERANCE_mV or more.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: One negative covers every disagreement, so the caller cannot tell a modest drift from a gross sensor failure, and the deviation is not returned.
return_contract.evidence: STD_RETURN_TYPE_e has exactly two members, STD_OK and STD_NOT_OK, declared at src/app/main/include/fstd_types.h L82-L85. The comparison is abs(diff_mV) < PL_STRING_VOLTAGE_TOLERANCE_mV at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L83, and diff_mV is voltageAfe_mV - voltageCurrentSensor_mV at L81.

validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value STD_RETURN_TYPE_e. No assertion guards either voltage argument, so an out-of-range value is not detected here.
validity_signalling.evidence: The verdict is the return at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L85; the only guard on the element is on the output pointer of the cell-level variants.

timing.evidence: A pure comparison with no period of its own. The cadence on which a caller repeats it is not stated at this boundary.

concurrency.evidence: Called from a task. The function reads only its arguments and one compile-time tolerance, holds no state and takes no lock, so it is re-entrant in practice, but the source does not state that.

error_paths.observed_behaviour: Returns STD_NOT_OK and writes no value.

error_paths.condition: either argument is out of any physical range
error_paths.observed_behaviour: Not detected. The comparison proceeds on whatever value is passed.
error_paths.evidence: No assertion on either argument at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L77-L86.

not_specified_by_source: The tolerance PL_STRING_VOLTAGE_TOLERANCE_mV is named in the comparison but the header does not state its value, its unit, or how it is configured.
The signed difference is not returned, so a caller that wants to grade a near-miss cannot.
The interface does not state which of the two measurements is authoritative, and it does not average them the way the cell-level elements do; it returns a verdict only and no value.

elements.declaration: extern STD_RETURN_TYPE_e PL_CheckCellVoltage(int16_t baseCellVoltage, int16_t redundancy0CellVoltage, int16_t *pCellVoltage);

parameters.name: baseCellVoltage
parameters.meaning: Cell voltage from the base measurement chain.
parameters.valid_range: No range is checked. The source records the omission deliberately with an AXIVION suppression at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L93.

parameters.name: redundancy0CellVoltage
parameters.meaning: Cell voltage from the redundant measurement chain.
parameters.valid_range: No range is checked; the omission is recorded at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L94.

parameters.name: pCellVoltage
parameters.meaning: Receives the average of the two measurements, written whether or not the two agree.

values.STD_OK: The two cell voltages differ by less than PL_CELL_VOLTAGE_TOLERANCE_mV.
values.STD_NOT_OK: The two differ by PL_CELL_VOLTAGE_TOLERANCE_mV or more.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: One negative covers every disagreement. More seriously, the averaged value is written to the output in both cases, so a caller that ignores the return value receives a plausible-looking value built from a measurement the element has just rejected.
return_contract.evidence: STD_RETURN_TYPE_e has exactly two members, STD_OK and STD_NOT_OK, declared at src/app/main/include/fstd_types.h L82-L85. The comparison is at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L99 and the average is written unconditionally at L103.

validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value STD_RETURN_TYPE_e plus a non-null assertion on the output pointer. A failed check is observable, but only if the caller reads the return value.
validity_signalling.evidence: The verdict is the return at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L104; the averaged value is written at L103 before that return, on both paths.

timing.evidence: A pure comparison with no period of its own.

timeouts.name: PL_CELL_VOLTAGE_TOLERANCE_mV
timeouts.value: named by the source, value not stated in the header
timeouts.meaning: The largest cell-voltage disagreement between the two chains that the element accepts as plausible.
timeouts.evidence: The comparison abs(baseCellVoltage - redundancy0CellVoltage) > PL_CELL_VOLTAGE_TOLERANCE_mV is at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L99; the macro is used but its definition is not in the header this record transcribes.

concurrency.evidence: Called from a task; the function reads no database and holds no state, so it is re-entrant in practice, but the source does not state that.

error_paths.observed_behaviour: Returns STD_NOT_OK and still writes the average to pCellVoltage.
error_paths.evidence: The average is written at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L103 and the return at L104 is reached on both paths.

not_specified_by_source: The two voltage arguments have no range check and the source records that omission on purpose, so a nonsensical count reaches the average.
The header does not state the value of PL_CELL_VOLTAGE_TOLERANCE_mV or where it is configured.
The interface does not say whether the averaged output is meaningful when the verdict is negative, and it writes it anyway; that is a contract question the source leaves open.
The integer average at L103 truncates, so two cell voltages differing by one count average to the lower of the two; the source does not state a rounding rule.

elements.declaration: extern STD_RETURN_TYPE_e PL_CheckCellTemperature(int16_t baseCellTemperature, int16_t redundancy0CellTemperature, int16_t *pCellTemperature);

parameters.name: baseCellTemperature

parameters.valid_range: No range is checked; the omission is recorded at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L111.

parameters.name: redundancy0CellTemperature

parameters.valid_range: No range is checked; the omission is recorded at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L112.

parameters.name: pCellTemperature
parameters.meaning: Receives the average of the two temperatures, written on both the accepted and the rejected path.

values.STD_OK: The two cell temperatures differ by less than PL_CELL_TEMPERATURE_TOLERANCE_dK.
values.STD_NOT_OK: The two differ by PL_CELL_TEMPERATURE_TOLERANCE_dK or more.

return_contract.default_on_no_information: As for the voltage variant, the average is written on the rejected path as well, and the single negative cannot distinguish a small disagreement from a failed sensor.
return_contract.evidence: STD_RETURN_TYPE_e has exactly two members, STD_OK and STD_NOT_OK, declared at src/app/main/include/fstd_types.h L82-L85. The comparison is at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L118 and the average is written unconditionally at L122.

validity_signalling.mechanism: Return value STD_RETURN_TYPE_e plus a non-null assertion on the output pointer.
validity_signalling.evidence: The verdict is the return at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L123; the average is written at L122 before that return, on both paths.

timing.evidence: A pure comparison with no period of its own.

concurrency.evidence: Called from a task; no state, no lock, no database access.

error_paths.observed_behaviour: Returns STD_NOT_OK and still writes the average to pCellTemperature.

not_specified_by_source: The header does not state the value of PL_CELL_TEMPERATURE_TOLERANCE_dK or how it is configured.
The unit of the two arguments is not stated in the parameter names; only the tolerance macro carries a unit suffix, so the record infers dK from that and says so rather than asserting it.
As with the voltage variant, the source does not say whether the averaged output is meaningful when the verdict is negative.

interface_level_gaps.gap: All three elements return a verdict and, for the cell-level pair, also write an averaged value on the rejected path.
interface_level_gaps.consequence: A caller that consumes the output without checking the return receives a value the element has just declared implausible. The interface does not state that the output is only meaningful when the verdict is STD_OK, so the burden falls entirely on the caller.
interface_level_gaps.evidence: The average is written unconditionally at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L103 and L122, with the return following at L104 and L123.

interface_level_gaps.gap: The tolerance each element applies is named in the source but its value and configuration point are not stated in any header this record transcribes.
interface_level_gaps.consequence: The number that decides whether two independent measurements agree is not part of the interface as read, so the acceptance threshold is not reviewable from the boundary itself.
interface_level_gaps.evidence: PL_STRING_VOLTAGE_TOLERANCE_mV is used at src/app/application/plausibility/plausibility.c L83, PL_CELL_VOLTAGE_TOLERANCE_mV at L99 and PL_CELL_TEMPERATURE_TOLERANCE_dK at L118, with no definition in plausibility.h.
